title: Missing Ring Part 3
description: Missing Ring Part 3 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Nelly Virago

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect the missing Ring Ropes from the monsters in Mutant Mania and deliver them to Chairman Manchair in All-Amateur Assault.

Quest Reward: 20,000 Gold

Return to: Chairman Manchair

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Missing Ring Part 4

Tip: It is pretty easy to collect the Ropes. The problem is fighting back to All-Amateur Assault to collect.
